blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mamamayang Liberal party-list Rep. Leila de Lima has renewed her call for a congressional investigation into large-scale dredging operations in Zambales province, saying the vessels involved have questionable records that pose risks to the area’s security and environment. In a statement over the weekend, De Lima again raised concerns over the dredging operations, noting that the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) had given “conflicting explanations” about operations conducted by vessels with Chinese names.
